serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Shanice: And? It wasn’t that bad, right?
Bot: It wasn’t, but it doesn’t mean I trust you.
Shanice: Ugh! That kinda hurt me!
You: So? What did you learn from the data?
Shanice: I got something, but it’s not much. Most of it is corrupted. Someone tried really hard to erase all the data on her.
You: Why would someone do that?
Shanice: No idea.
Shanice: We don’t have any dates, but I recovered some coordinates.
Shanice: One of them is an empty field in mainland China. Turns out you are Chinese after all {f_botName}!
Shanice: There’s also some place in this city, inside the abandoned part.
You: We should check it out.
Shanice: I agree, but I must warn you. It’s quite dangerous there.
Bot: We will manage. Me and {f_playerName}, that is.
Shanice: What?! I’m going too! 
Bot: Tch!
Shanice: Don’t ‘tch!’ me! I helped you!
Bot: Fine. You can come with us.
Shanice: Alright then!
Shanice: Give me a call when you are outside with {f_botName}. I will come pick you up. But do it after 18:00 and before 23:00. I need to go to bed early so I don’t have baggy eyes.
Bot: If we don’t forget. 
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceSerious
Shanice: Please don’t forget, it would make me very sad.
You: Don’t worry Shanice, I will not forget. You can go now.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: So cold! 
Shanice: Alright then. Have fun you two and see you later!
